title: streptanthus rigidus
intro: Streptanthus rigidus, commonly known as the rigid monkey flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a perennial wildflower native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America, known for its unique, nodding yellow and purple flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the severity of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include glucosinolates, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory effects.
